title: hub-status
description: Payload published retained by the hub plugin to renewvan/hub/status. Reports the Raspberry Pi's own local-network address, read from the Pi itself, so it exists whether or not a router Device is installed, and the version of the hub (this repo's compose stack and schema) the Pi was deployed from. Published every 30 s and on change.

ip.description: The Pi's primary local-network IPv4 address: the source address of its default route (so never a Docker bridge or the Tailscale address). Null when the Pi has no default route.

hostname.description: The Pi's hostname, or null when it cannot be read.

version.description: The version of the hub deployed on the Pi, stamped by bin/deploy.sh from the deploying checkout's 'git describe --tags --always --dirty' (a release tag, a tag-plus-commits string, a bare commit hash, or a '-dirty' variant of any of those), or the literal 'dev' when no stamp was written. Same convention as the Device info 'version'. Never read from a hand-edited file in the repo.
